checks.value: The information found on our website is not part of this or any other report we file with

triage.note: ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. Microsoft FY2013's Item 1 is interleaved with an unnumbered Item 401(b) disclosure: Item 1 body (~37,695 chars) -> 'EXECUTIVE OFFICERS OF THE REGISTRANT' heading + ~4,712 chars of officer bios -> a ~1,643-char 'Available Information' paragraph (website URL, SEC filings availability, the sentence this case anchors on) that is genuine Item 1 content -> the Item 1A heading. ADR-019 rules that src/sec10k/segment.py's EXEC_OFFICERS_RE clip (added to fix 7 fixtures where this unnumbered section was silently swallowed into a numbered item at confidence 0.95) should stay in place on msft-2013 even though it costs this fixture something the other 6 don't lose: INV-S2 requires a span to be one contiguous verbatim slice, so no single span can keep the trailing website paragraph while dropping the officer bios sandwiched between it and Item 1's real close. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: the two candidate spans are both imperfect -- (a) pre-fix: Item 1 runs through the bios and the website block, correctly keeping the trailing content but confidently attributing 4,712 chars of Part III Item 401(b) disclosure to Item 1 at confidence 0.95, the textbook silent-failure shape this milestone exists to hunt; (b) post-fix (shipped): Item 1 stops cleanly at the bios heading, correctly excluding the bios, but loses the trailing 1,643-char website paragraph to no item at all -- it now sits in the unattributed gap between Item 1's new end (offset 44075) and Item 1A's start (offset 50430). ADR-019 rules (b) is the better trade: over-attributing another item's content is worse than a boundary-tightness loss the item's own 30,000-65,000 char length band still comfortably tolerates (post-fix Item 1 measures 37,695 chars). WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: a capability this pipeline does not have and the T8 freeze forbids without its own ADR -- either (1) a third span kind that can name a discontiguous or 'orphaned between items' region so the website paragraph is captured without being falsely claimed as Item 1's contiguous verbatim close, or (2) accepting the pre-fix trade for this one fixture only, which would need a per-fixture exception this repo does not have a mechanism for and should not build one just to special-case a single document. The one text_contains check above is the whole of the debt -- it fails today because the anchor sentence sits outside every item's span, and is expected to stay red until a post-freeze ADR admits one of the two capabilities above. Tagged 'debt' on the ba-2003/cvx-2015 precedent: it runs every suite and is excluded from the score, so the loss stays visible without breaking the gate or being rewritten to assert it as correct. If it ever goes green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.

provenance: T11 (2026-08-19), authored from ADR-019's msft-2013 ruling (docs/evals/audits/2026-08-19-t11-silent-failure-sample.md finding #13, generalized to 7 fixtures by the T11 recurrence scan). This is the anchor removed from evals/golden/msft-2013-content.json's Item 1 checks when the EXEC_OFFICERS_RE clip made it go dead -- moved here verbatim, not deleted, per CLAUDE.md hard rule 2 and the case-authoring skill's provenance convention. Verified against src.sec10k.extract.extract_items('evals/fixtures/msft-2013/filing.htm')['normalized_text'] (HTML fixture, verified against the pipeline's own canon-correct rendering rather than raw-byte grep, same method as this fixture's structure/content cases): the anchor sentence 'The information found on our website is not part of this or any other report we file with, or furnish to, the SEC.' occurs exactly once, at offset 50283 -- strictly between Item 1's post-fix end (44075) and Item 1A's start (50430), confirming it is genuinely orphaned rather than merely under-measured. Document length 312,483 chars. The three invariant checks (no_empty_success, no_overlap_ordered, verbatim) are there so this case still notices if the fixture's spans stop being well-formed, exactly as in ba-2003-asterisk-ibr.json and cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json; the item_present check pins status=extracted as the correct, unchanged call -- a bookkeeping check, not part of the debt, that would fail loudly if some future change wrongly reclassified Item 1 rather than closing the real gap. Watched red against the fix already landed in src/sec10k/segment.py, per CLAUDE.md hard rule 2 (the fix predates this case only because the earlier agent that authored EXEC_OFFICERS_RE did not yet know msft-2013 needed a debt row -- ADR-019 supplies the ruling and this case supplies the required red evidence for it now, before commit).
